keyword: high output diesel concrete pump off-grid

title.en: Printed-row question: Which off-grid pump prints 100 m³/h
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：哪台无电网泵印了 100 m³/h

description.en: Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists it for very high output infrastructure pours and twin-engine diesel power: 290 kW total, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, 150 m horizontal / 500 m vertical, aggregate 6 cm and below and 8000 kg. The selection guide’s high-output diesel question also names LZ-80, whose low-pressure mode is ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa, not 100 m³/h at 40 MPa. How many engines are printed? Two units of 145 kW, 290 kW total.
description.zh: 柴油120。河北品锦机械（邢台）把它列为超大排量基建浇筑和双柴油机动力：合计 290 kW、100 m³/h、40 MPa、料斗 0.6 m³、水平 150 m / 垂直 500 m、骨料 6 cm 及以下、8000 kg。选型指南的大排量柴油问题还点了 LZ-80，其低压模式是 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa，不是 40 MPa 下的 100 m³/h。两台 145 kW，合计 290 kW。6 cm 及以下是上限。它不是最小石子。这一页点名了大坝或工厂项目吗？
